strategy_rules: Daily bet = the single highest-ranked pick, fired ONLY when it is High or Elite confidence
If the top pick is only Medium/Low confidence, NO bet that day (capital preservation)
Pick ranked by confidence then model probability — NOT market edge/EV (prediction-first)
Validated on the walk-forward with real closing odds + $10 compound bankroll (30% stake):
top-1 single Elite/High only: 76.0% hit (38-12), $10->$91, NEVER dipped below the $10 start
top-1 single any tier: 67.1% hit (47-23), $10->$27; Elite-only: 86.7% (13-2) but too rare
Rejected: the prior 2-leg calibrated parlay was a 52.9% coin-flip (37-33) that drew down to $0.81 — the cause of the live losing streak
Singles at 76% win 3 of 4 and grow the bankroll faster and far safer than parlays
Track accuracy on /accuracy and season walk-forward record
